@graph.description: Agency Height lists NPN-verified insurance agents in a searchable national directory. Create a free profile, get matched to local buyers, and manage leads.

mainEntity.name: Do I get carrier access, or just leads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. Markets gives you carrier access, search carriers by appetite, request access in a click, and submit to some wholesale carriers with no appointment needed. And beyond Markets, tools like profile listing, intake forms, and Lead Bank keep leads coming in. AH Markets

mainEntity.name: How do insurance agents get leads on Agency Height?

acceptedAnswer.text: Four paths. (1) Your public profile: a buyer finds your listing and submits a request straight to you, exclusive. (2) Your campaign link: share your form anywhere, every submission is yours alone. (3) Platform matching: a buyer picks from up to 3 matched agents, so the same lead can go to up to 3 of you. (4) Lead Bank: unclaimed requests you claim by state and line, exclusive once claimed, capped by plan (Premium 2/mo, Enterprise 7/mo). On Free, paths 1 to 3 still arrive, but you can open full details on only 2 leads before upgrading.

mainEntity.name: What is insurance agent lead generation through a directory?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buyers find you through search instead of you chasing them. Someone searches for a licensed agent in their state, sees your verified profile, and submits a request. No cold calling, no bought list. Agency Height matches by licensed state, line, and profile quality.

mainEntity.name: How does my insurance agent profile affect my ranking in the directory?

acceptedAnswer.text: State and line match come first. Among agents who pass, ranking weighs NPN verification, profile completeness, plan tier, recent activity, response speed, and ratings. A verified, complete, fast-replying profile on a paid plan outranks a dormant or incomplete one.

mainEntity.name: Is Agency Height free for insurance agents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Create a profile, get NPN verified, and start receiving leads free. Free doesn't block leads, it limits how many you can open in full: after 2, you upgrade to see the rest. Lead Bank claims and the Recommended badge need a paid plan, Premium ($29.99/mo) or Enterprise ($79.99/mo), billed annually.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from buying leads from QuoteWizard or EverQuote?

acceptedAnswer.text: They sell leads in bulk to several agents at once, so you pay per lead and compete with up to 3 or 4 others who got the same contact. Here, a buyer finds your profile and chooses you, and that request is yours exclusively. Lead Bank claims are exclusive too, one agent per lead.

mainEntity.name: What lines of insurance are included in the directory?

acceptedAnswer.text: Personal lines (auto, home, renters, umbrella), Commercial, and Life. Health isn't included. Your coverage types come from your NPN license data, so only lines you're licensed for show publicly.

mainEntity.name: How does insurance agent SEO work with my profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your profile is a standalone, indexable page, with your name and location in the URL and your states and coverage in the content. That helps it rank when buyers search for a local agent. A fuller profile with reviews ranks better on Agency Height and in search.

mainEntity.name: Can I share my profile on social media and business cards?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Share your profile URL and Lead Form link anywhere, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, your Google Business Profile, business cards, or a QR code. Every submission lands in the same My Leads inbox as your matched leads.
